thoma.finding: Skill queues exactly one Blazing Blessing AttackTagElementalArt with snapshot and damage delays of 11 frames, directly during the active action invocation; this is covered by the ordinary AbilityInvocation queue receipt.
Separate +9 Core task computes the skill shield and invokes genShield; it is not a damage producer.

genShield performs non-damage shield refresh math and queues a +1 Core task which only calls Shields.Add. This branch has no terminal attack; no extra shield lifecycle dependency is needed for Thoma E damage.
A1 changes shield-strength stacks only. C1 changes skill cooldown only; C6 attack modifier applies only Normal/Extra/Plunge tags, not E.

kirara.finding: Native dispatcher normalizes any nonzero short_hold to 1; this branch takes precedence. Otherwise positive hold is capped at 600 frames; zero/nonpositive hold selects Tap.
Tap E queues one Tail-Flicking Flying Kick direct action attack at +14 frames; shield generation is not damage.
Short Hold schedules one Urgent Neko Parcel AttackEvent at +17 Core frames and one direct Flipclaw Strike at +48; other delayed work is A1/shield only.
Long Hold schedules roll tasks at i=16; i<=effectiveDuration+12; i+=30 and one direct Flipclaw Strike at duration+36; duration is already capped in Skill.
All rolling ticks reuse one *info.AttackEvent d, mutating only d.Pattern per scheduled task; the A1 callback only changes shield stacks.
A1 grants stacks on roll impacts and creates shield absorption when invoked; it emits no attacks.

C2 is co-op only/unimplemented. C4 Steed of Skanda is a later independent OnEnemyDamage event listener already instrumented at kirara.c4.cardamom; it is explicitly outside the Kirara E intrinsic direct/tick contract.
